explication: rgthree-comfy is a ComfyUI extension combining custom workflow nodes, canvas and workflow usability features, and model-information/configuration services. Users build or adjust graphs in ComfyUI; its execution invokes the extension’s backend nodes and returns workflow outputs, while frontend services track execution and support graph interactions. The README documents more node capabilities than the sampled source verifies; those are represented at their existing source paths without asserting internal wiring. Backend model routes and frontend model-info calls are included where excerpts show their responsibilities.
